description: Task manager with Todoist, Nextcloud & CalDAV support designed for GNOME

latest_release.name: Planify 4.21.0
latest_release.body:
Planify 4.21.0 brings offline support for CalDAV, Nextcloud and Nextcloud Deck, a more reliable Todoist sync, client certificates (mTLS), attachments that keep working after the original file moves, and many fixes and memory improvements.

New Features:

- Added offline support for CalDAV and Nextcloud: tasks, sections and calendars can be created, edited, completed, moved and deleted without a connection, and are sent on the next sync.
- Added offline support for Nextcloud Deck: cards, stacks and boards work without a connection, including moving cards between boards.
- Added client certificate (mTLS) authentication for CalDAV and Nextcloud, with .pem and .p12/.pfx files.
- Attachments are now copied into Planify's data folder, so they keep opening after the original file is moved or deleted. Files can also be attached while creating a task.
- Added dragging tasks in All Tasks onto sidebar lists and onto other tasks to make them subtasks.
- Added sort and filter options to the Label view.
- Added sorting by deadline in projects, Today, Scheduled, filters and labels.
- Added setting a deadline on multiple selected tasks.
- Recurring tasks now move their deadline to the next occurrence, keeping the same distance from the date.
- Tasks with only a deadline now appear on their deadline day in Scheduled.
- Added an option to delete all completed tasks in a project.
- Added an optional "Use Adwaita Colors" switch in Appearance.
- Added choosing the color when creating a label from the label picker.
- New projects remember whether the last one used an emoji or the progress icon.
- Quick Find shows completed tasks separately, after the other results.
- Backups now include preferences, and Today and Scheduled sort by due date by default.
- Reminders on recurring tasks are kept after they fire, so the next occurrences notify too.

Sync:

- Todoist: Planify now backs off when Todoist rate-limits it (HTTP 429), and shows when syncing will resume.
- Todoist: fixed changes made on the web being skipped after creating or editing a task in Planify.
- Todoist: tasks, projects and labels deleted on the web are now removed after a full sync.
- Todoist: offline changes are no longer lost when a request fails, are sent in order, and are sent in batches of 100.
- Todoist: fixed invalid sync tokens being sent or stored, and project descriptions now sync both ways.
- CalDAV: fixed moving a task to another list or section deleting the wrong copy on servers without MOVE support.
- CalDAV: fixed moving a task to a section of the same project, and tasks losing their section when the server lists them first.
- CalDAV: relative reminders and due date timezones from apps like Tasks.org are now kept when editing a task.
- CalDAV: fixed labels being dropped when another account had a label with the same name.
- CalDAV: fixed project names and colors from servers that use CDATA (e.g. Fastmail), and completing tasks on servers that answer 200 OK.
- Syncs no longer run on every network change or pile up periodic timers, and a sync no longer starts while another one is running.
- Network requests now time out after 30 seconds instead of hanging.

Bug Fixes:

- Fixed a crash when moving a single task from the multi-select toolbar.
- Fixed reminders set in Quick Add being lost on save.
- Fixed automatic reminders firing after turning reminders off.
- Fixed completing Nextcloud Deck cards, which were archived instead of marked as done.
- Fixed the "Add tasks" button missing from Deck stacks in list view.
- Fixed subtasks missing from views until a restart, and subtasks shown twice in All Tasks.
- Fixed moved tasks staying greyed out.
- Fixed Quick Add breaking the title when picking a label after non-ASCII text.
- Fixed backup file names that cloud storage rejects, and the backup list reloading entirely.
- Fixed the sidebar order in Preferences resetting, and the wrong style being selected in Appearance.
- Fixed the reminder popover closing when adding a reminder,

[![Please do not theme this app](https://stopthemingmy.app/badge.svg)](https://stopthemingmy.app) [![License: GPL v3](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-GPL%20v3-blue.svg)](http://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0)

Planify

Never worry about forgetting things again

![Planify Screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alainm23/planify/main/data/resources/screenshot/screenshot-03.png) ## ✨ Features ### 🎯 Core Functionality - **🚀 Modern Interface**: Clean, intuitive design that gets out of your way - **🤚 Drag & Drop**: Effortlessly organize tasks and projects with natural gestures - **💯 Progress Tracking**: Visual indicators show completion status at a glance - **📂 Smart Organization**: Group tasks into sections for better workflow management - **📅 Calendar Integration**: Visualize your schedule and plan your day effectively - **⏰ Flexible Reminders**: Set multiple reminders per task - never miss a deadline - **🌙 Dark Mode**: Seamless integration with system themes - **🔍 Quick Search**: Find anything instantly with powerful search capabilities ### ☁️ Cloud Synchronization - **Todoist Integration**: Full sync with your existing Todoist account - **Nextcloud Support**: Keep your data private with self-hosted solutions - **Offline Mode**: Work without internet - sync when you're back online - **Cross-Platform**: Access your tasks from anywhere *Note: Planify is not created by, affiliated with, or supported by Doist* ### 💎 Advanced Features - **🔔 Smart Notifications**: Never miss important tasks - **🔁 Recurring Tasks**: Set up repeating schedules with flexible patterns - **📊 Analytics**: Track your productivity over time - **🏷️ Labels & Filters**: Organize and find tasks with custom labels - **📎 Attachments**: Add files and links to your tasks - **🎨 Customization**: Personalize colors and themes ## 📥 Installation ### 🏪 Official Distribution ### 🛠 Build from Source
System Requirements & Dependencies **Minimum Requirements:** - Linux distribution with GTK4 support - 2GB RAM - 500MB disk space **Build Dependencies:** | Package | Version | |---------|---------| | meson | ≥ 0.56 | | valac | ≥ 0.48 | | gio-2.0 | ≥ 2.80.3 | | glib-2.0 | ≥ 2.80.3 | | gee-0.8 | ≥ 0.20.6 | | gtk4 | ≥ 4.14.4 | | libsoup-3.0 | ≥ 3.4.4 | | sqlite3 | ≥ 3.45.1 | | libadwaita-1 | ≥ 1.5.3 | | json-glib-1.0 | ≥ 1.8.0 | | libecal-2.0 | ≥ 3.52.4 | | libedataserver-1.2 | ≥ 3.52.4 | | libportal | ≥ 0.7.1 | | libportal-gtk4 | ≥ 0.7.1 | | libsecret-1 | ≥ 0.21.4 | | libspelling-dev | latest | | gtksourceview-5 | 5.12.1 | | libicu-dev | ≥ 76.1 | **Install Dependencies:** **Fedora/RHEL:** ```bash sudo dnf install vala meson ninja-build gtk4-devel libadwaita-devel libgee-devel libsoup3-devel libportal-devel libportal-gtk4-devel evolution-devel libspelling-devel gtksourceview5-devel libicu-devel ``` **Ubuntu/Debian:** ```bash sudo apt install valac meson ninja-build libgtk-4-dev libadwaita-1-dev libgee-0.8-dev libjson-glib-dev libecal2.0-dev libsoup-3.0-dev libportal-dev libportal-gtk4-dev libspelling-1-dev libgtksourceview-5-dev libicu-dev ```
**Build Instructions:** ```bash # Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/alainm23/planify.git cd planify # Configure build meson build --prefix=/usr # Compile cd build ninja # Install sudo ninja install # Run io.github.alainm23.planify ``` ### 🏗️ Development Setup **Using GNOME Builder:** 1. Install [GNOME Builder](https://apps.gnome.org/Builder/) 2. Clone this repository 3. Open the project in GNOME Builder 4. Click "Run" to build and test ## 🤝 Contributing We welcome contributions! Here's how you can help: ### 🐛 Bug Reports & Feature Requests - Check [existing issues](https://github.com/alainm23/planify/issues) first - Use our issue templates for better communication - Include system information and steps to reproduce ### 💻 Code Contributions - Read our [Architecture Guide](ARCHITECTURE.md) - Review our [AI Policy](AI_POLICY.md) for guidelines on AI-assisted contributions - Fork the repository and create a feature branch - Follow our coding standards and commit message format - Submit a pull request with a clear description ### 🌍 Translations Help make Planify available in your language: - **Weblate (Recommended)**: [Join our translation project](https://hosted.weblate.org/engage/planner/) - **Manual**: Check our [Translation Guide](po/README.md) ## 📋 Code of Conduct Planify follows the [GNOME Code of Conduct](https://conduct.gnome.org/). We are committed to providing a welcoming and inclusive environment for all contributors. **Our Principles:** - **Be friendly** - Use welcoming and inclusive language - **Be empathetic** - Respect differing viewpoints and experiences - **Be respectful** - Disagree politely and constructively - **Be considerate** - Remember that decisions often involve competing priorities - **Be patient** - Help others learn and grow - **Be concise** - Read discussions before commenting ## 💝 Support the Project If you find Planify useful, consider supporting its development:
